text:
maria: Hey folks — thinking about a casual spring hangout next Friday (May 8). Idea: Bodega picnic + ping-pong mini-tournament + lowkey happy hour. 5:30–7:30? Bring a snack or drink if you can. Quick yes/no and bringers?

jamal: Love that. I'm in. 5:30 works for me.

sophia: In! I can bring a bluetooth speaker + playlist. 5:30 good.

devon: Count me. I can bring a collapsible ping-pong net and paddles. Prefer vegan options for snacks pls.

alice: I'll take drinks — non-alc options and 2 cases of sparkling water. Any preference on beer? I can bring a couple cases if people want.

maria: Awesome — thank you! Can we make it peanut-free? We had an allergic incident a while back so let's be safe.

jamal: Good call. I'll run the ping-pong bracket. Quick format: single-elim, best-of-3 for semis/final. React with :hand: if you want to play, :cheese: if you're bringing snacks, :cup_with_straw: to bring drinks.

sophia: :hand: to play. Also :cheese: I can bring a batch of hummus + pita (vegan).

devon: :hand: :cheese: I can bring fruit skewers and napkins.

alice: :cup_with_straw: and I'll add two local IPAs for whoever wants. I'll label the cans.

maria: I'll reserve a couple picnic blankets and bring utensils/plates. Ops-bot please confirm picnic area availability?

ops-bot: Booked: Bodega Park — North Lawn reserved Fri May 8, 5:15–8:00pm. Permit #BP-4492. Link: https://internal.calendar/reservations/BP-4492

jamal: Perfect. Should we set a backup in case of rain? Maybe the 9th same time?

sophia: +1 backup for Sat 5/9. If it rains we'll move to the common room on the 10th floor and do pizza + board games.

maria: Backup noted. Final list of volunteers: jamal (bracket), sophia (music + hummus), devon (net + fruit), alice (drinks). I'll bring blankets/plates/utensils. Anyone else want to bring games? Cornhole? Bocce?

nick: I can bring cornhole boards and beanbags.

maria: Amazing. OK I'll post a short RSVP form tomorrow and put this thread into the calendar invite. Thanks y'all! :party-parrot:
